prompt_template:
You are given the following document as context.

<context>
{context}
</context>

Answer the following questions based ONLY on the document above:
1. List the three most important concepts or components mentioned.
2. What are the key architectural decisions or trade-offs described?
3. Summarize the document in exactly 3 bullet points.

Respond in JSON with keys: "concepts", "decisions", "summary".

files.name: small

files.description: Architecture specification (~500 lines). Moderate redundancy, expect 40-60% savings.

files.name: large
